hints.tr: İlk adım şöyle olur: `      - name: Get the code` ve altında `        uses: actions/checkout@v4`.
hints.en: The first step becomes `      - name: Get the code` with `        uses: actions/checkout@v4` below it.

hints.tr: `with:` artık `uses:` ile aynı hizada kalmalı: ikisi de aynı adımın parçası.
hints.en: `with:` must stay in the same column as `uses:`: both are part of the same step.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Get the code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: python -m pytest
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Get the code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: python -m pytest
```
